rationale: Both candidates independently rediscover real, diff-grounded issues (absent-vs-empty base_schedule, boundary-vs-interval step-count inconsistency between legacy/distilled paths), but Y also engages the single dominant thread of the actual ground-truth discussion — whether/how to integrate with the existing DMD2PipelineMixin — giving it materially better recall against what reviewers actually cared about. X compensates with a sharp, well-verified catch (Ref2VA inheriting FL2VA's global shift scales) that closely mirrors the ground truth's core per-partition concern, and X's findings are more conservatively hedged with an explicit verification trail, giving it higher precision. Y's package-placement complaint directly contradicts a decision ground-truth reviewers actually made (and the author implemented), and its specific import-timing numbers and 'CI gates are red' claim are unverifiable/likely embellished, denting its precision. Actionability favors Y slightly due to clearer Major/Medium/Minor triage and more decisive fix recommendations.
